depiction.primary_object: U-shaped arrow curving around left and pointing right

ambiguity: Easily confused with undo, reply, refresh, or loop/repeat icons unless paired with its opposite arrow.
task_intents: redo a failed or botched task
send back borrowed or rented item

reasoning: The icon is an abstract directional U-turn / redo / forward arrow used primarily as UI chrome rather than depicting a concrete task subject. While it can loosely cue actions like forwarding, redoing, or returning items, concrete object icons (envelope, package, document) are almost always clearer and less ambiguous in a to-do list.
